title: ChronoSynth: Constraint-Aware Question Synthesis over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge graph question generation (KGQG) generates natural-language questions from structured graph evidence and a target answer. When the input graph is temporal, a valid question must also preserve the answer field, time condition, reference event, and temporal order that determine the answer set. Existing KGQG methods and prompting baselines can produce fluent questions that alter these conditions, causing temporal semantic drift. This paper studies temporal KGQG as a constraint-preserving graph-to-question problem and proposes ChronoSynth, a memory-augmented and constraint-aware generation framework. ChronoSynth first constructs a Temporal Intent State to make the intended question semantics explicit. It then retrieves compatible typed question patterns from an indexed pattern memory, adapts them to the input graph, and validates the generated question. Validation feedback guides revisions when a supported inconsistency is detected

translated_title: ChronoSynth：面向时序知识图谱的约束感知问题合成方法
translated_abstract: 知识图谱问题生成（KGQG）旨在根据结构化图证据和目标答案生成自然语言问题。当输入图谱是时序图谱时，一个有效的问题还必须保留决定答案集合的答案字段、时间条件、参考事件和时间顺序。现有的KGQG方法和提示基线可能生成流畅但改变了这些条件的问题，从而导致时序语义漂移。本文将时序KGQG研究为一个保持约束的图到问题转换问题，并提出了ChronoSynth——一个记忆增强且约束感知的生成框架。ChronoSynth首先构建时序意图状态，使预期的问题语义显式化；然后从索引化的模式记忆库中检索兼容的带类型问题模式，将其适配到输入图谱，并对生成的问题进行验证；当检测到可支持判定的不一致时，验证反馈会引导对问题的修订。
tldr: 本文提出ChronoSynth框架，通过构建时序意图状态、检索适配带类型问题模式并进行验证修订，解决了时序知识图谱问题生成中的时序语义漂移问题，确保生成的问题保留决定答案集合的关键时间约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ChronoSynth, a memory-augmented, constraint-aware framework that addresses temporal semantic drift in temporal knowledge graph question generation by constructing temporal intent states, retrieving and adapting typed question patterns, and validating generated questions to preserve the constraints that determine the answer set.
